build_mask2former_swin_config: build a Mask2Former config with Swin-Tiny backbone for COCO panoptic segmentation
create_swin_backbone_config: create a SwinTransformer backbone config with embed_dims 96 and depths [2,2,6,2]
configure_optimizer_settings: configure optimizer with custom learning rate multipliers for backbone and embedding layers
